content_value: Between Biaxial and Uniaxial Geogrid and Cellular Confinement Technologies, Geosynthetics Have Been at the Forefront of Soil Stabilization Applications Since 1959.

Ballast fouling is one of the most costly and problematic maintenance repairs that commercial and industrial railroads encounter annually. BaseLok BallastGuard was developed as specialized geocomposite designed to eliminate the "pumping effect" in railway track sections. By combining a rigid high-strength BaseLok Geogrid, with a proprietary non-woven geotextile, BaseLok BallastGuard provides unmatched subgrade reinforcement and ballast fouling mitigation.

BaseLok BallastGuard is a proven deterrent to ballast fouling and has been utilized on many Class 1 Railroads and Industrial Rail Facilities, nationwide.

• Railway Tracks: Prevents ballast contamination and enhances track stability.
  • High-Speed Rail Corridors: Maintains alignment and reduces maintenance under dynamic loads.
  • Freight Rail Networks: Supports heavy axle loads and improves durability.
  • Railway Yards & Sidings: Ensures stable ground conditions in high-traffic zones.

100% US Sourced & Manufactured
50+ Years Proven Technology

• Enhanced Separation: Prevents mixing of ballast and subgrade, maintaining track integrity.
  • Improved Stability: Increases load distribution and reduces track deformation under heavy loads.
  • Reduced Maintenance: Minimizes ballast degradation, lowering tamping and replacement needs.
  • Efficient Drainage: Allows proper water flow, preventing waterlogging and weakening of tracks.
  • Long-Term Durability: Extends the lifespan of railway infrastructure with consistent performance

• Baselok BallastGuard is primarily used in railway infrastructure to improve stability, durability, and performance of ballast systems.
  • • Railway Tracks – Prevents ballast contamination and enhances track stability.
  • • High-Speed Rail Corridors – Maintains alignment and reduces maintenance under dynamic loads.
  • • Freight Rail Networks – Supports heavy axle loads and improves durability.
  • • Railway Yards & Sidings – Ensures stable ground conditions in high-traffic zones.
  • • Track Rehabilitation Projects – Extends life of existing tracks by improving ballast performance.
  • • Subgrade Stabilization – Enhances load distribution and minimizes settlement.

Baselok BallastGuard is a high-performance geosynthetic solution engineered to prevent the mixing of ballast with subgrade soil while maintaining proper drainage. Its robust structure improves load distribution, reduces ballast degradation, and enhances track stability under repeated dynamic loads.

Compared to conventional methods, Baselok BallastGuard significantly reduces maintenance requirements such as tamping and ballast replacement. It performs effectively under heavy traffic conditions, extending the service life of railway tracks and ensuring consistent performance.

Designed specifically for railway applications, Baselok BallastGuard enhances track integrity, minimizes settlement, and supports efficient drainage. It also contributes to cost savings and improved operational efficiency over the long term.
